name: engagelab-apppush
description: Local full-stack implementation of a simplified EngageLab AppPush platform (technical assessment).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev:worker -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,worker "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start:worker -w backend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
